name: Camera
author: Opal Kelly Incorporated
summary: Machine vision image capture with a hardware ISP, real-time RGB histograms, and object detection.
description: Streams live video from an Opal Kelly FPGA board and its camera peripheral through a hardware image-signal-processing pipeline with bad pixel correction, demosaicing, auto white balance, and adjustable color gains. Includes real-time red, green, and blue histograms, YOLO object detection with bounding boxes and class labels, and a hardware test pattern generator so the app runs with no camera attached.
